rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or process of making or producing something.

example.english: The rendering of this film took a whole year.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅製作前後搞咗成年。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zai3 zok3 cin4 hau6 gaau2 zo2 seng4 nin4

rows.note: Use this for a translated version of a text, book, or work.

example.english: I think this rendering is easier to understand than the original.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢個譯本比原著易明。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 jik6 bun2 bei2 jyun4 zyu3 ji6 ming4

rows.note: Use this in computer graphics for producing an image from a digital model, or for the resulting render in that context.

example.english: The image is still rendering, so it is not ready for release.
example.traditional: 張圖仲渲染緊，未出得街。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 tou4 zung6 syun3 jim5 gan2 mei6 ceot1 dak1 gaai1
